document.abstract: Is it reasonable to expect that broadcasting operations can occur with no on-premise infrastructure? In this paper, we will explore the necessary hardware and software configurations, cloud-based models, and on-demand coordination of necessary resources. Examples of the technologies and methodologies that will be discussed include: Services, Network Service Orchestration, Control of Workflow Applications, Virtualized Infrastructure and Software Applications, and the Physical Infrastructure Layer. — This paper will highlight the usage of Flexible Media Clusters, Software Defined Networking and Network Function Virtualization, OpenStack, Packet Media Networking solutions to replace SDI, software defined storage and resource reservation layers to elastically and dynamically provide a highly scalable all-IP based broadcasting architecture.
